login.title: your project

login.signedOut: You're signed out. See you soon!

verify.text: Click the button to open your project space.

proofing.label: Selection
proofing.title: pick your favourites
proofing.intro: Tap ♥ on the photos you love — those are the ones I'll edit. Open a photo to see it large and leave a note right where you'd like something changed.
proofing.noNotes: No notes yet. What should I change?
proofing.pinHint: Tap the photo where your note belongs
proofing.confirmText: After sending, your selection is locked and I start editing.
proofing.confirmExtra: That's {extra} more than included ({price} each) — I'll get back to you about those.

proofing.noPreviews: No previews yet — you'll get an email as soon as they're ready.
proofing.keys: ← → to browse · P to pick · Esc to close
